title: Technical Officer - Rural Development
apply_instructions: Email resume and cover letter to recruitment@lmw.vic.gov.au by 5pm Wednesday 14 October 2026. Confidential discussion: Vural Karakurt, Manager Rural Services, 0418 363 362 (phone only).
rationale: State water corporation technical officer role (Band 3) on irrigation and drainage requirements for subdivisions, referrals, field inspections and records; Marc's stormwater drainage design coursework and Philippine site inspection and reporting work overlap.
Mandatory items are driver's licence, criminal history check, fit for work and right to work; Marc holds a licence, is willing to undergo checks and has full work rights to December 2027.
Regional Victoria (Mildura) is an acceptable location; relocation is open to discussion only.
caution: Role asks for sector experience, GIS and CRM systems, legislation interpretation and development approval knowledge; Marc's experience is short (under one year of site work in the Philippines) and he has no GIS or Victorian water entitlement experience. Mildura is about 550 km from Melton; relocation needs Marc's confirmation.
gaps: No GIS or CRM platform experience in facts
No Australian development approval or statutory referral experience
No Victorian water entitlement framework knowledge
Site experience under one year (Apr 2019 to Feb 2020)
employer_line: The role reports to the Manager Rural Services and advises on irrigation and drainage requirements for subdivisions and developments across Lower Murray Water's rural service area in north west Victoria.
